steps.description: The world: a central plaza with the giant card machine and a conveyor belt rolling priced cards past it, ringed by 8 player bases and statues of 8 of the pullable brainrot characters, with a holographic card floating over the machine. Every base is full of cards, each wearing a big floating tag with its name and earnings. Players start with $250K. Walk to the machine lever and hold E to pull a card for $20K: a giant card flips out of the machine in public with a coloured rarity beam, so everyone nearby sees what you got — or buy a card straight off the belt instead.

Inside the player's base: all 8 stands filled with strong cards — Epic, Legendary, Mythic and Secret pulls, some mutated — each standing tall with its name and earnings floating over it, and the HUD income line running into millions per second after two rebirths (income x2.0). After a pull you carry the card on your back, slowed (walk speed 16 down to 11); walk close to a free stand and the card auto-places and earns cash every second. A luck shop sells timed boosts (up to x5) that fatten the odds of Epic-and-better pulls. Tension: other players can steal a placed card with a 2-second hold. Defend with your bat — one hit knocks a carried card loose — or step on the lock pad for a 60-second shield dome (90-second cooldown) that blocks all steals.

The collection page: all 18 brainrot cards with their pictures, rarities and earnings per second, across six rarities — Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Mythic and Secret. The cast earns from $5K/s for a Common up to $1.75M/s for the Secret Void Velvet Velociraptor. The mutation ladder runs along the bottom: a pull can land Gold (10% chance, x2 earnings), Diamond (5%, x3) or Rainbow (3%, x5), shown in the card's glow, name and tag.

The raccoon thief event: every few minutes a server-wide red banner counts down the raid while the thief dashes into an unlocked, occupied base and grabs a placed card. The owner can bat the card loose mid-escape, or lock the base to call the raid off. Rebirthing costs $500K the first time and doubles with each rebirth: cash resets to the $250K start and placed cards clear, but each rebirth pays a permanent +50% income multiplier and +1 base stand (6 stands at first, up to 8), so every new run earns faster than the last.
